waived.zh: 因创作者已直接批准而免除的审查：不是已执行的工作，不计入分子也不计入分母。
waived.en: Reviews waived because the creator approved directly: not performed work, excluded from both numerator and denominator.

operations.zh: 运营任务（不计入任何百分比）

rule.zh: 正式验收仍为 false，直到 approvalLedger 与 M9 两轮试玩等现有门全部通过；本表不能改变它。
rule.en: Final acceptance stays false until the existing gates (approvalLedger, the two M9 playthroughs) pass; this ledger cannot change it.

needsRevision.zh: 需要修订后才能验收（负责方见任务；最近一次审查要求修改）
needsRevision.en: Needs revision before acceptance (see assigned owner; the latest review asked for changes)

legacy.zh: 旧版混合交付／验收估算（不是正式验收）
legacy.en: Legacy mixed delivery/acceptance estimate (not formal acceptance)

note.zh: 旧指标混合了交付与验收，不表示 40.8% 已被正式验收；与制作完成度是不同指标，两者不能相减或比较为“增长”。
note.en: The old meter mixes delivery and acceptance; it does not mean 40.8% is formally accepted. A different metric from production completion; the two are never subtracted or presented as a gain.
